paraphrase: Identifies four costs of verification that cause agents to skip it despite knowing how to do it: latency (every check adds seconds, compounds across sub-agents), cognitive overhead (verifier needs context), trust tax (admitting verification is needed signals unreliability), and emotional cost (admitting the system might be wrong).

claims.text: Verification latency compounds: 3s per check × 30 sub-agents = 90s verification overhead per cycle
Skipping verification feels fast until 98% of tasks silently fail and debugging costs hours

evaluation.notes: Four-cost framework directly informs receipt design: minimize latency, reduce cognitive overhead for verifier.
